items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Robichaud, any chance? No, no, no. Or P. Rohn? [INTERVIEWEE] I can't think of that man's name right now.

ctx.x: Well, there's one man that he worked with, was very famous, but he was a violinist. Oh, I can't think of that man's name now. He was very famous.
Robichaud, any chance? No, no, no. Or P. Rohn?
I can't think of that man's name right now. No, he was way back, way before those fellas.
